name: get_kms_issuer
description:
Retrieve a single KMS issuer by its ID for the selected team.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId} --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
